proposals.evidence: DEDR3999 gives Tamil paḻa/paḻacu/paḻaiya old, Malayalam paḻavan old man, Kota pay-/pa-/payd, Kannada paḻa/paḻasu and Konda paṛay old. These survey paḻ-/paś-/pay-/pag-/hal-/al- responses are comparative old-family forms with ordinary adjectival or human endings; the survey old gloss is preserved, including where the elicited form denotes an old person. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1404 gives Tamil kaṉa be heavy and kaṉam heaviness, Malayalam kanam/kanakka heavy. These simple kana/kanam/ganama and ordinary kanamānatɨ heavy responses match that weight family. DEDR explicitly says the family is influenced by Sanskrit ghana; the proposal retains that contact caveat and does not claim an uncontaminated inherited history. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
